title: Water-extractable organic matter from tropical soils and biochar amendment tailors the colloidal behavior of nanoparticles and mitigates their toxicity through molecular eco-corona formation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1871-1895
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01164G, Paper
Laís G. Fregolente, João Vitor dos Santos, Gabriela H. Da Silva, Theodoro da R. Salles, Simone G. S. dos Santos, Luelc S. Costa, Gabriela A. Nogueira, Márcia C. Bisinoti, Carlos A. Pérez, Patrick G. Hatcher, Iseult Lynch, Diego Stéfani T. Martinez
The molecular composition of soil organic matter governs eco-corona formation on CuONP; biochar amendments and Amazonian dark earth WEOM enhance aromatic diversity and binding sites, strengthening the eco-corona and reducing nanoparticle toxicity.
